title: Apply a discount coupon at checkout
description_text:
As a registered customer I want to apply a discount coupon to my cart at checkout so that I pay less for eligible orders.

Marketing will run percentage and fixed-amount coupons. Coupons can have a minimum spend and an expiry date. The discount should be shown clearly before payment.
acceptance_criteria_text:
1. Customer can enter a coupon code on the cart page and apply it.
2. A valid coupon reduces the order total and shows the discount as a separate line.
3. Invalid or expired coupons show an appropriate error message.
4. Only one coupon can be used per order.
5. The discount must not make the total negative.
